title: Credit Counseling Administrative Decisions
description: The United States Trustee Program's duties include approving nonprofit budget and credit counseling agencies (credit counseling agencies) for inclusion on a publicly available list of approved credit counseling agencies. If a United States Trustee decides not to approve or to remove a credit counseling agency from the approved list, that credit counseling agency may obtain administrative review of the decision from the Executive Office for U.S. Trustees. This link provides a copy of the Executive Office's administrative decisions, although certain information has been redacted

publisher.name: Executive Office for United States Trustees
